'''Atchorb''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Atchorb system/Legends|Atchorb system]] of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] linked Atchorb to the [[D'ian system/Legends|D'ian]] and [[Ulicia system/Legends|Ulicia systems]], while the [[Authority Guardian Corridor]] connected it to the [[Hiit system/Legends|Hiit]] and [[Tothis system/Legends|Tothis systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Atchorb was a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world, albeit one of middling importance despite vast prior investments. That changed, however, when the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] began shipping military units onto the world, which used it as staging grounds for operations in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] areas northward of the Corporate [[Sector/Legends|Sector's]] borders, such as [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]]. As a result, Atchorb experienced an economic boom.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Atchorb was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
